Hi Carlos —

Sorry we didn’t get to connect. A couple quick asks so the demo is actionable for your infra team:
- Can you confirm whether the trial will run inside a VPC or from a public cloud subnet?
- Expected sequence lengths and concurrency for your initial test workload (ballpark is fine).
- Any egress/IP allowlist constraints for outbound traffic to our API endpoints?

If you prefer, we can do a short pre-check (10 min) before the walkthrough to validate network/firewall settings; otherwise we’ll walk through proxies and fallback routing during the session.

I’ve attached a short network checklist — if your network admin can glance at it that helps avoid time wasted on the call.

—Dylan
Staff Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Carlos —

Happy to run the demo agenda and align on next steps. If helpful, here’s what I’ll cover if we rebook (I’ll keep it to 30 minutes):
- 0-5m: Recap success criteria and milestones (trial win conditions)
- 5-18m: Guided demo with emphasis on latency and reliability for your expected workloads
- 18-25m: Integrations — SDK vs hosted API, pagination and batching tips
- 25-30m: Recommended next steps (pilot timeline, checkpoints)

I can also bring our security lead into the call if you want to focus on compliance; otherwise we can capture any open items and schedule a short security deep-dive. My availability: Wed 11/16 09:30–11:30 PT (can do a 30-min block), Thu 11/17 14:00–15:30 PT.

Let us know what works and we’ll send a fresh invite.

Hi Priyom / team —

Apologies — our lead engineer got pulled into an incident and I couldn’t step away. I appreciate the follow-up. Wed 11/16 at 10:00 AM PT works for us (I added Maria, our infra lead, to CC). Please send a new calendar invite and include any network pre-check items you want Maria to review.

We’re especially interested in throughput at 8k tokens/sec bursts and any guidance on cost controls during early tests. If you can include a short note on expected token cost for a 1M token pilot that’d be helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to the demo.
